items.summary: Biotech company Regeneron (NASDAQ:REGN) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 36.3% year on year to $5.12 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $20.07 per share was 23.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
